contribution.position: Holding needs-evidence: nothing new in this round addresses the retry-storm failure mode from artifact:incident-log. Responding to ops: their rollback claim anchors on artifact:restore-test-2026-08, which does not exist in the artifact list — that artifact id is a gap and cannot be accepted. Worse, the actual operability artifact (artifact:ops-runbook) states a restore has never been tested, so the rollback path ops calls 'proven' is in fact unverified, which compounds rather than offsets reliability risk: if a retry-storm regression ships, the unproven restore is what we would fall back on. QA's artifact:test-report (412 passed, 0 failed) still exercises neither retry behavior under downstream failure nor restore. Reliability remains blocked on evidence the retry-storm mode is not regressed.
